product.description: A tool to conduct practical phishing exercises that prepare employees to recognize and respond to phishing attacks.

product.name: Breaches
product.description: A real-time data breach detection service that monitors employee-related data leaks and alerts teams to potential risks.

product.name: Inbox
product.description: A 24/7 AI-powered cybersecurity hotline inbox that collects and classifies suspicious emails reported by employees for analysis and response.

product.name: Employee Security Posture Management Platform
product.description: A platform that integrates employee cybersecurity training, phishing simulations, breach detection, and threat reporting to manage and improve security posture.
